findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::a build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3
findings.title: A build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3
findings.action: No change: the spec routes only exit 0 to the resume check; any other exit reaches the hold check, which needs labels and a held store before anything is read.
findings.disposition_rationale: build-progress read exits only 0, 3 or 2 (usage); a usage fault there is unreachable with the arguments the command builds.

occurrences.title: A build-progress read exit other than 0 or 3 falls through to the hold check like exit 3

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::setup-worktree.sh resolves the worktree root through faff on path, so with none it uses the home default while the root assert uses the configured root
findings.title: setup-worktree.sh resolves the worktree root through faff on PATH, so with none it uses the HOME default while the root assert uses the configured root
findings.action: The provisioner now runs with this install's bin dir first on PATH, so it calls the same worktree-root resolver as the step-6 assert; every other variable passes through unchanged. Regression test 'the provisioner resolves the same worktree root with no faff on PATH' fails without the fix.

occurrences.title: setup-worktree.sh resolves the worktree root through faff on PATH, so with none it uses the HOME default while the root assert uses the configured root

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/worktree-ensure.ts::a symlink at the recreate path escapes the root: the pre-add check compared path text only
findings.title: A symlink at the recreate path escapes the root: the pre-add check compared path text only
findings.action: Before the add: a symlink (dangling or not) or any entry at the path, other than the registered-worktree reuse case, is resume-recreate-failed, and the path's real parent must sit under the real root. Tests: a symlink to an outside dir and a dangling symlink; no worktree is registered in either.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec section 4.4 promises the check happens before the add.

occurrences.title: A symlink at the recreate path escapes the root: the pre-add check compared path text only
